notes: «وقال الليث حدثني يونس» names another transmitter (Layth) for the same saying: marked variant and not a route (rule 4); the Zuhri tail is written once after it and belongs to the route
«عن حديث، عائشة» : «حديث» is the narration, not a link; the last link is Aisha
Scenes (Barira, Ali, Usama, the Prophet's words to them) are not links; the Prophet ends the chain
